result.description: Set yourself in motion with this technical waterproof hiker. It offers elevated comfort, protection, and versatility, with responsive Techlite Plush cushioning, a Navic Fit secure lacing system, and a gripping outsole to tackle multiple terrains. Built with our OutDry waterproof membrane with seamless, breathable construction, these hikers add a TPU heel clip and mid foot support for stability. The outsole is fitted with burly 5mm lug traction that’s specifically designed for hiking. Columbia offers these men’s mid hiking shoes in multiple colors and sizes.

top_reviews.title: Nice quality boot but this style did not work well for me
top_reviews.text: As a woman, I am looking for a winter riding boot that fit well, be warm and stirrup friendly. Everything I read on these boots seemed to be very positive, and when they arrived they seem very well made.  However, the zip style and shorter height did not fit well around my ankle, and felt very clumsy.  I returned these and am ordering the taller lace up style, hoping those will work.
